feedback: Approved for racing. This candidate is the iteration-7 build exactly: sensors at y=0.07 with x from -0.05 to 0.05, weights [-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1], sensor_size 0.012, kp 3.0, ki 0.2, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.0 and line_loss 'last_direction'. Iteration 7 scored 162.45, the best raced result, and it is the only build with full evidence on all three tracks. The Optimizer's kd 0.35 test (iteration 8, score 131.41) cut oval progress from 0.741 to 0.683 and s-bend progress from 0.312 to 0.160, so kd stays at 0.4. I am not requesting a kd change in this race. Read the race as follows. Expect results close to iteration 7. If oval progress is near 0.74 and s-bend progress near 0.31 with max_error still around 0.06, the next lever is kp 3.5 with kd 0.4 and ki 0.2, because the kp 2.5 to 3.0 step gained a little and did not hurt. If the race drops well below iteration 7 on any track, do not change kd or ki again; return to this exact build. Keep base_speed at 1.0 until at least one track finishes or runs to near progress 1 without leaving the line, since survival still comes first.
requested_changes: After race 9: if oval progress is at or above about 0.74 and s-bend at or above about 0.31 with max_error below 0.06, keep kd 0.4, ki 0.2, y=0.07 and try controller.kp 3.5 in the next revision, since the kp 2.5 to 3.0 step (iteration 7) raised the score from 160.17 to 162.45.

After race 9: if oval progress falls below about 0.67 or s-bend below about 0.28, return to this exact build (kp 3.0, kd 0.4, ki 0.2). Iteration 8 showed that kd 0.35 cut bend progress sharply, and iteration 6 showed that ki 0.3 lowered the score.

Keep geometry.sensor_positions at y=0.07 and base_speed at 1.0 until a track finishes or nearly finishes without leaving the line, because iteration 5 confirmed the forward-sensor lever and speed has not yet been tested on this build.
